<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the distinct chemical shift values are 166.40, 144.78, 132.00, 130.07, 127.80, 52.24, 49.55, 43.55, and 19.23 ppm. Identical shifts (130.07 and 127.80 each appear twice) correspond to equivalent carbons. Therefore, there are 9 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
